correctness.rationale: The ten displayed facets form the neighborly six-vertex closed surface with Euler characteristic one. I independently enumerated all \(6^6=46656\) vertex maps and obtained exactly 6396 simplicial self-maps with image-size distribution 6,930,5400,0,0,60. The 60 surjective maps are exactly the facet-preserving permutations. Every non-automorphism has simplex image. Reconstructing the one-coordinate contiguity graph from the definition gives one component of size 6336 and 60 isolated automorphisms; the symbolic one-coordinate interpolation proves that this graph has the same components as full contiguity. Independently evaluating the stated \(\mathbb F_2\) cycle/cocycle pair gives nonzero H1 action on exactly those same 60 automorphisms, while all other maps act by zero.
risks: This is a finite-model theorem for one triangulation; it says nothing about maps after subdivision.
The computational part is exhaustive but order-specific.

value.rationale: The minimal triangulation of \(\mathbb{RP}^2\) is a canonical finite model, and a complete self-map/contiguity classification is a natural invariant. The sharp dichotomy—one null contiguity class versus isolated automorphisms, exactly detected by mod-two H1 action—gives structural information unavailable from the automorphism group alone.
risks: The result is model-specific and does not automatically survive subdivision.
